v3_review_conclusion.summary: Correct the BERT criterion, pin the v3.0 RNN-T/LibriSpeech profile and define the 600-minute phases and comparable result before execution.

revision_candidate.test_name: Run MLPerf Inference v3.0 RNN-T 99 Offline
revision_candidate.purpose: Execute the approved MLPerf Inference v3.0 RNN-T normal-accuracy Offline configuration, verify LibriSpeech speech-recognition accuracy plus LoadGen/compliance validity, measure Offline samples per second, and compare with a signed comparable v3.0 result.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: Exact SUT/GPU topology, driver/runtime, v3.0 container/harness commit, RNN-T model, approved LibriSpeech data/preprocessing and configs. Other ASR pipelines/releases are not interchangeable.
revision_candidate.target_scope: RNN-T 99 Offline only across the declared GPU set. BERT, Server and 99.9 are excluded. Machine Time 600 and Attended Time 90 require an approved mapping to accuracy, performance, compliance and setup phases.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: Pinned v3.0 harness/container; licensed model/audio/preprocessing hashes; configs; accuracy/performance/compliance commands; 600-minute phase map; WER/accuracy and Offline samples/s criteria; comparable result ID; tuning, memory/storage, thermal/power and recovery limits.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Verify hashes/configs and baseline health, then run RNN-T 99 accuracy, Offline performance and required compliance phases exactly as the pinned v3.0 implementation specifies. Preserve audio/preprocessing identity, WER output, full LoadGen logs, phase timing and telemetry. Do not run BERT validation.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Conflict corrected; artifacts licensed/pinned; GPUs healthy; adequate memory/storage/cooling/power; tuning/load/recovery approved.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: System/GPU identity; all hashes/configs; LibriSpeech preprocessing manifest; exact commands/timing; RNN-T WER/accuracy result; complete LoadGen logs and valid Offline samples/s; compliance; GPU memory/power/thermal/XID/ECC/host logs; named comparable result and normalized comparison; final health.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: Signed v3.0 RNN-T 99 Offline rules and comparable result. Pass requires required speech accuracy/WER, valid LoadGen/compliance, samples/s comparison and clean health. BERT or throughput alone is invalid.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: Do not mix model/accuracy/scenario/release, use unlicensed audio, alter preprocessing/tuning without approval, expose restricted data, clear logs, suppress invalidity or claim official status.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: Benchmark/data/platform owners approve artifacts, preprocessing, reference, 600-minute plan and load; a human judges result.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: Humans correct BERT and decide phase/reference. The Agent runs only the pinned RNN-T workflow.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: Stop on invalidity or limits, preserve permitted evidence, terminate cleanly, restore tuning/services and verify health before rerun.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: BERT conflict, phase plan or reference unresolved; wrong model/scenario/release; missing license/config; WER/LoadGen/compliance failure; memory/storage exhaustion; topology drift; XID/ECC/thermal/power/host limit; evidence loss.

identified_defects: No LibriSpeech/WER or comparable result identity.
reason_for_change: Require RNN-T's own speech-accuracy/preprocessing evidence rather than copied BERT language and preserve the long-run intent.

objective_improvement_over_v2: Compared with V2, this contract traces the acoustic workload from the approved LibriSpeech preprocessing manifest through the RNN-T word-error-rate calculation, expressly preventing a high samples-per-second result from substituting for speech accuracy; it also assigns each part of the ten-hour window to named benchmark phases.

agent_understanding_result.notes: Static review preserves RNN-T-specific speech accuracy and Offline semantics; no DUT validation.
